verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs state that it supports creating and managing repositories and browsing commit history and code files. Hands-on reports confirm it works as a self-hosted Git server with a familiar GitHub-like interface, and that repos can even be auto-created as private on first push. One user saw a large repo's Activity tab take nearly 90 seconds to load, which suggests history views can be slow at scale. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of repo-management and commit-history features (the doc evidence is a one-line summary), and independent evidence that history browsing performs well on large repositories.
